summary: Vylor Inc., the spun-off agriculture unit of Corteva, filed an 8-K after the SEC declared effective its Form 10 registration statement. Corteva will distribute one Vylor share for every Corteva share held of record as of September 24, 2026, with the separation expected to complete and regular-way NYSE trading under 'VYLR' to begin October 1, 2026. No when-issued or ex-distribution trading will occur. No price, premium, or advisor is stated. Watch the October 1 debut for index-inclusion flows, initial holder selling pressure from Corteva investors, and early guidance from the new standalone management.
